import re, json

# 1. Fetch up to 5 recent multimodal RAG papers from arXiv
cmd = "curl -s 'https://api.arxiv.org/search/query?query=multimodal+RAG&search_type=all&start=0&max_results=5&sort=last-updated'"
curl_res = run_command(cmd)
if curl_res['exit_code'] != 0:
    raise SystemExit("curl command failed")

# 2. Save the raw JSON response to a file for easier parsing
write_file('api_output.txt', curl_res['stdout'])

# 3. Read the file content
raw_json = read_file('api_output.txt')

# 4. Locate the "entry" array (the list of paper objects)
arr_start = raw_json.find('"entry": [')
if arr_start == -1:
    raise SystemExit("Could not find entry array")
# Find matching closing bracket by tracking braces/brackets
depth = 0
i = arr_start
while i < len(raw_json):
    ch = raw_json[i]
    if ch == '{':
        depth += 1
    elif ch == '}':
        depth -= 1
    elif ch == '[':
        depth += 1
    elif ch == ']':
        depth -= 1
        if depth == 0:
            arr_end = i
            break
    i += 1
else:
    raise SystemExit("Failed to locate end of entry array")

entries_section = raw_json[arr_start:arr_end + 1]

# 5. Parse each entry
entries = []  # list of (year, method, key_result)
for raw_entry in entries_section.split('},{"'):
    # Ensure each piece is a valid JSON object
    entry_str = raw_entry.strip()
    if not (entry_str.startswith('{') and entry_str.endswith('}')):
        continue
    try:
        entry = json.loads(entry_str)
    except Exception:
        continue

    # Extract required fields
    title_match = re.search(r'"title"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', entry)
    year_match = re.search(r'"published"\s*:\s*"(\d{4})-\d{2}-\d{2}"', entry)
    summary_match = re.search(r'"summary"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', entry)

    if not (title_match and year_match and summary_match):
        continue

    title = title_match.group(1)
    year = year_match.group(1)
    summary = summary_match.group(1)

    # Derive a simple "method" label from the title (first word)
    method = title.split()[0]

    entries.append((year, method, summary))

# 6. Build the markdown document
md_lines = [
    "# Research: Multimodal RAG Papers",
    "",
    "## Comparison Table",
    "| Year | Method | Key Result |",
    "|------|--------|------------|",
]
for yr, meth, res in entries:
    md_lines.append(f"| {yr} | {meth} | {res} |")
    md_lines.append("")

md_content = "\n".join(md_lines)

# 7. Write the markdown file
write_file('research.md', md_content)
print("research.md created successfully")
